pr_bodies.email-fix:
🤖 *This is an automated pull request from Repo Assist.*

## Problem

`createBeerTasteResultsEmail` used a triple-quoted F# string for the body. F# triple-quoted strings preserve literal whitespace, so every line after the first carried ~20 spaces of source indentation. Outgoing emails looked like:

```
Hi Alice,

                    The results for the beer tasting event "..." are now available!
```

## Fix

Replace with a string list joined by `\r\n` (RFC 2822 line endings). Each line is an explicit literal with correct indentation.
